subject: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API & secure transfer
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@buyco.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-27T14:02:31-07:00
Subject: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API & secure transfer

Hi Laura,

Hope you’re well — we’re working through BuyCo’s SIG and CAIQ review for third parties and I need the most recent penetration test report you have for Redwood’s Hosted API so our InfoSec team can validate findings and remediation timelines.

Could you confirm:
- Which assessments cover the Hosted API surface (external network, auth, API abuse/fuzzing, web console)?
- The date of the test and whether the report can be shared externally in full or only redacted?
- Preferred secure transfer method (S3 presigned link with IP restriction, password-protected ZIP via secure courier, or VDR)?

Also, if you have an itemized remediation status for any critical/ high findings we’d appreciate that for risk acceptance.

We need this by EOD next Wednesday (2026-06-03) to keep our review on schedule.

Thanks — please loop in whoever from your security team.

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Senior Security Analyst, BuyCo
security@buyco.com

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@buyco.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T16:10:44-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API & secure transfer

Alice — thanks for the note and the timeline. I’m looping in Soojin (security) and Markus (legal) to coordinate.

Quick answers up front:
- We have a full penetration test covering the Hosted API control plane, public API endpoints, authentication flows, and customer-facing console (no on-prem code). The last full external pentest was completed 2024-11-15.
- We typically provide a redacted PDF of the full report for external sharing; unredacted reports require an executed NDA and a short justification.
- Standard transfer options: (1) time-limited S3 presigned URL (can be IP-restricted) + password-protected ZIP, (2) upload to our VDR (requires recipient account), or (3) scheduled secure SharePoint link. We prefer (1) for speed.

Soojin — can you confirm which findings are still open and prepare the redacted report + short remediation summary? Markus, FYI on potential NDA if BuyCo needs the unredacted report.

Alice — once Soojin confirms, I’ll send the secure link and a short checklist of what’s redacted. If BuyCo requires unredacted, let me know and I’ll coordinate an NDA.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-28T09:20:03-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API & secure transfer

Laura / Markus — Per Laura’s request, I prepared the artifacts and a concise remediation status. Overview:

1) Report metadata:
- Report: Redwood_HostedAPI_PenTest_Report_2024-11-15
- Scope: External black-box assessment of public API endpoints, auth/session management, web console (customer portal), and common injection/Fuzz vectors. No internal-only network scans or customer data replays were performed.
- Tester: Third-party assessed by Redwood (NCC Group partner).

2) Sharing policy and options (recommended):
- We will provide a redacted PDF (sensitive evidence removed) via an S3 presigned ZIP link that expires in 7 days. The ZIP is password-protected; password will be delivered in a separate email or via your security Slack channel.
- If BuyCo needs the unredacted report, we require an executed NDA and an access request. Once NDA is in place we’ll grant a VDR session with IP allowlisting.

3) Remediation status (high/critical items):
- Critical: External auth token refresh path vulnerability — remediated 2025-02-11, validated in a follow-up verification scan.
- High: Rate-limiting gaps on legacy endpoints — mitigations deployed to gateway 2025-03-05; monitoring alerts added. Patch verification completed 2025-04-02.
- Medium/Low: Multiple findings around header misconfig/low-risk info disclosure — mitigations scheduled and completed across late 2025; one low-risk item pending backport for an older runtime (target 2026-07-15).

4) Artifacts included (redacted): Redwood_HostedAPI_PenTest_Report_2024-11-15_redacted.pdf; pen-test-findings-summary-2024-11-15.csv (CSV mapping finding id -> status).

5) Sharing logistics I prepared for you:
- Presigned link (expires 2026-06-04 09:20:00-07:00): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-secure-share/rdw_pen_test_20241115_redacted.zip?X-Amz-Expires=604800&signature=EXAMPLE
- Password: sent in a separate short message for security.
- If BuyCo wants IP restriction please send the IPs to security@redwood.com and we’ll configure the presigner accordingly.

Let me know if you want the unredacted packet (I’ll initiate the NDA flow with Markus).

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@buyco.com>, BuyCo Security Team <security@buyco.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:05:12-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API & secure transfer

Hi Alice — looping you back with the artifacts and the secure link. Per our security team the redacted report and findings summary are available at the presigned URL below and will expire in 7 days. We’ll send the password in a separate message for added security.

Presigned link: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-secure-share/rdw_pen_test_20241115_redacted.zip?X-Amz-Expires=604800&signature=EXAMPLE
Attachments (redacted): Redwood_HostedAPI_PenTest_Report_2024-11-15_redacted.pdf; pen-test-findings-summary-2024-11-15.csv

If you need the unredacted material for an in-depth review, we can proceed with an NDA and a VDR session. Please reply with your preference and any IP addresses to restrict the presigned URL to.

For our tracking, HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765 (Deal ID: HB-2026-0031).

Thanks and please confirm once you’ve downloaded the files.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142
